name_zh: 斯特罗斯纳/巴拉圭/独裁/三国/色党/德国/巴西/伊泰普/阿尔弗雷多
description_zh: 阿尔弗雷多·斯特罗斯纳 (1912-2006) 巴拉圭总统 (1954-1989) 长期独裁者，建立COLORADO党，建立三国同盟，与巴西合作开发伊泰普水电站，与德国合作开发工业，与巴西庇护国建立长期合作关系，推动巴拉圭现代化，被誉为'独裁者'，建立长期独裁政权。
description_en: Alfredo Strasser (1912-2006) Paraguayan President (1954-1989) long-term dictator, established COLORADO Party, established Three Nations Alliance, cooperated with Brazil to develop Iguazu Hydroelectric Power Station, cooperated with Germany to develop industry, established long-term cooperative relationship with Brazil shelter country, promoted Paraguayan modernization, known as 'Dictator', established long-term dictatorship.
reason_zh: 斯特罗斯纳代表拉丁美洲如何建立长期独裁政权，如何通过党派建设和联盟实现国家控制，以及如何利用国际合作推动国家现代化，体现了拉美独裁政权的典型特征。
reason_en: Strasser represents how Latin American establishes long-term dictatorship, how party building and alliance achieve national control, and how international cooperation promotes national modernization, embodies typical characteristics of Latin American dictatorship.

分析1954 年上台/ COLORADO 党建设/长期独裁
探讨三国同盟/伊泰普合作/国际关系
评估独裁政权/ COLORADO 党/巴拉圭经济
总结独裁遗产/巴拉圭现代国家/斯特罗斯纳主义
steps_en: Study Strasser early military career/Paraguayan political environment/dictatorship idea
Explore Three Nations Alliance/Iguazu cooperation/international relations

expected_en: Understand how Latin American establishes long-term dictatorship, how party building and alliance achieve national control, and how international cooperation promotes national modernization.

case_en: 1954 Accession; 1954 COLORADO Party construction; 1956 Three Nations Alliance. Dictatorship/COLORADO Party/International cooperation/Paraguayan modernization endures.
